# Ananya-Women@Work

> > A DEIB consulting firm specializing in women leadership development, workplace inclusion, and organizational transformation across Asia and beyond.

Ananya-Women@Work is a consulting organization led by Madhujit Singh based in Hyderabad, India, offering comprehensive programs in diversity, equity, inclusion, and women's leadership development. The firm serves multinational organizations across manufacturing, pharma, and technology sectors with tailored workshops, mentoring programs, and compliance training.

## Key Topics

- Women Leadership Development
- Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging (DEIB)
- Unconscious Bias Training
- Mentoring & Coaching Programs
- Workplace Culture Transformation
- Emotional Intelligence
- POSH Act Compliance
- Employee Assistance Programs
- Inclusive Leadership
- Professional Development
- Career Advancement for Women
- Organizational Change
- Sexual Harassment Prevention
- Mental Health & Wellness

## Core Programs & Services

- [Women Leadership Potential](https://ananyawomenatwork.com/women-leadership-potential): Women leadership development program addressing glass ceiling in India
- [Project Inclusion](https://ananyawomenatwork.com/project-inclusion): Workshop program for workplace inclusion and leadership development
- [Unconscious Bias](https://ananyawomenatwork.com/unconscious-bias): Unconscious bias training and awareness program for inclusive workplaces
- [POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment)](https://ananyawomenatwork.com/posh): PoSH Act compliance training and sexual harassment prevention services
- [Mentoring & Coaching](https://ananyawomenatwork.com/mentoring-coaching): Mentoring Matters program with coaches Madhujit Singh and Sita Pallachola
- [Employee Assistance Program](https://ananyawomenatwork.com/employee-assistance-program): PositivvUs employee assistance program for mental health and wellness support

## Case Studies & Results

- [Enhancing Communication and Emotional Intelligence in a Rapidly Growing MNC Post-COVID](https://ananyawomenatwork.com/case-study/enhancing-communication-and-emotional-intelligence-in-a-rapidly-growing-mnc-post-covid): Case study of ANANYA program results in multinational organization across regions
- [Journey-Based Mentoring Program in Multinational Pharma](https://ananyawomenatwork.com/case-study/a-journey-based-mentoring-program-to-boost-confidence-among-senior-women-in-a-multinational-pharma-organization): Case study of ANANYA mentoring program success in pharma industry
- [ANANYA Program Impact in Traditional Manufacturing](https://ananyawomenatwork.com/case-study/how-the-ananya-program-empowered-women-and-transformed-leadership-dynamics-in-a-traditional-manufacturing-mnc): Case study of ANANYA program impact on women empowerment in manufacturing

## Workshops & Events

- [Events](https://ananyawomenatwork.com/events): Upcoming workshops and networking events for women leadership development
